documents.title: Public authority example
documents.content: Synthetic fixture only. System A owns current policy state and Archive B owns immutable originals. Current state and history remain distinct.

documents.title: Public operations guide example
documents.content: Synthetic fixture only. Read operations do not mutate external systems. Write operations require explicit authority and idempotency checks. SYNTHETIC_REVIEW_FLAG is an example workflow flag.

documents.title: Public automation workflow example
documents.content: Synthetic fixture only. Example flow: ingest event, perform deterministic parsing, validate uncertainty, produce a change set, require approval, then apply an idempotent local update.

documents.title: Public operations manual example
documents.content: Synthetic fixture only. Example projects are separated by responsibility and stable logical codes. This document contains no real workspace, resource, customer, property, or service identifiers.

documents.title: Public lifecycle transition example
documents.content: Synthetic fixture only. Missing calendar evidence alone does not finalize cancellation; SYNTHETIC_MANUAL_EVIDENCE is required. At synthetic D-45, use SYNTHETIC_RENEWAL_REVIEW with SYNTHETIC_AUTO_DATE.

documents.title: Public data model example
documents.content: Synthetic fixture only. Example contract totals belong to a contract record while example cash movements belong to a finance record. No real business data is represented.

documents.title: Public resource registry example
documents.content: Synthetic fixture metadata summary. PUBLIC.REGISTRY and PUBLIC.CONTEXT are example resources. External canonical URLs and service identifiers are intentionally absent.

documents.title: Public project context example
documents.content: Synthetic fixture metadata summary. PUBLIC.CONTEXT.A and PUBLIC.CONTEXT.B demonstrate versioned context records without real workspace bindings.

documents.title: Public reservation schema example
documents.content: Synthetic schema-only source. Example reservation fields include status, start and end timestamps, idempotency, and audit metadata. No rows are included.

documents.title: Public inspection schema example
documents.content: Synthetic schema-only source. Example inspection fields include assignment, scheduled and completed timestamps, exception reporting, idempotency, and audit metadata. No rows are included.
